en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Salma Bin Muhraz who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘It is upon with (eating of) Al-Sareyd, for I<sup>asws</sup> did not find anything more suitable than it’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Salmah ibn Muhriz who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me, ‘You should eat Tharid because I do not find anything more agreeable than Tharid.’”
